about: Fake CachedDataServer feed for console module tests. t is seconds from start_time. Built 2026-11-18 from NBP1406-like field names; values are synthetic.

Avg1mPortTrueWindSpeed.description: 1 min vector mean true wind speed

Avg1mPortTrueWindDir.description: 1 min vector mean true wind direction

scenarios.flr1_fails: FlrChl stops at t=228; logger flr1 FAILED from t=240 with stderr lines
scenarios.knud1_restart: Knud3Depth gap t=300..329; knud1 STARTING then RUNNING
scenarios.tsg_suspect: TsgTemp_QC goes 1 -> 3 at t=400 with a reason; TsgTemp keeps updating (SUSPECT + LIVE)
scenarios.wind_avg: Avg1m wind published once a minute (T=60 s)
scenarios.rad1_off: rad1 EXITED (off config) the whole time
